changeSet.sql:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS vw_report_loan_creditnoteoutstandingamount;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_report_loan_creditnoteoutstandingamount AS
-- Seguro Obrigatório + IVA SELECT ml.id , 10 AS nr_order , '(+) Seguro Obrigatório + IVA' AS nm_group_charges , disbursedon_date AS fecha , fee_charges_charged_derived AS amount FROM m_loan ml
UNION ALL
-- Credit Note SELECT ml.loan_id , 20 AS nr_order , '(-) Credit Note' AS nm_group_charges , credit_note_date AS fecha , -1 * (total_amount - current_interest - arrear_interest) AS amount FROM m_loan_credit_note ml WHERE total_amount - current_interest - arrear_interest > 0
UNION ALL
-- Transaction SELECT ml.loan_id , 30 AS nr_order , '(-) Transaction' AS nm_group_charges , ml.transaction_date AS fecha , -1 * (CASE WHEN transaction_type_enum = 29 THEN fee_charges_portion_derived / 2 ELSE fee_charges_portion_derived END) AS amount FROM m_loan_transaction ml WHERE is_reversed = FALSE AND transaction_type_enum IN (6, 29) AND fee_charges_portion_derived IS NOT NULL;
